senses.en: to start to use a method, plan, or idea
senses.pattern: adopt a method / adopt a new approach / adopt a policy
senses.example: After several complaints, the school decided to [[adopt]] a new approach to teaching math.
senses.example_zh: 接到幾次投訴後，學校決定採用新的數學教學方法。

senses.en: to formally accept a proposal by voting
senses.pattern: adopt a resolution / adopt a proposal / be adopted unanimously
senses.example: The student council [[adopted]] the proposal to ban plastic straws by a vote of twenty to three.
senses.example_zh: 學生會以二十票對三票正式通過了禁用塑膠吸管的提案。

gsat.sentence: Systems using movable arms were popular in Chicago, while those using the red and green lights were [[adopted]] in San Francisco.
Over the years, the fearless tribesmen have stood strong against slavery, and resisted the urging of the Kenyan and Tanzanian governments to [[adopt]] a more modern lifestyle.

senses.en: the practical use of something
senses.pattern: practical applications / the application of technology / have wide applications
senses.example: The new material has many practical [[applications]], from lighter airplanes to stronger bicycle frames.
senses.example_zh: 這種新材料有許多實際應用，從更輕的飛機到更堅固的腳踏車車架都用得上。

senses.en: the act of putting a substance onto a surface
senses.pattern: the application of sunscreen / regular application / for external application only
senses.example: Regular [[application]] of sunscreen is necessary if you plan to stay outdoors all afternoon.
senses.example_zh: 如果你打算整個下午待在戶外，就必須定時塗抹防曬乳。
senses.note: 動詞 apply 也有「塗、敷」之意

gsat.sentence: Today, the ancient art form has found a new [[application]] in the hands of contemporary artists.

senses.en: to officially give someone a prize or honor
senses.pattern: award sb a prize / be awarded a medal / be awarded a scholarship
senses.example: The committee [[awarded]] her a full scholarship for her outstanding research on ocean pollution.
senses.example_zh: 委員會因她在海洋污染方面的傑出研究而授予她全額獎學金。

senses.en: to decide officially that someone should receive money
senses.pattern: award damages / award compensation / be awarded two million dollars
senses.example: The court [[awarded]] the injured worker two million dollars in damages after a long trial.
senses.example_zh: 經過漫長的審理，法院判給受傷的工人兩百萬美元賠償金。

gsat.sentence: The 2011 Nobel Peace Prize was [[awarded]] jointly to three women for the efforts they made in fighting for women’s rights.
Two years later, it was [[awarded]] first prize again at Houston’s first annual Invention Fair.

senses.en: to feel almost sure that something is true
senses.pattern: I bet (that)… / I'll bet… / you can bet (that)…
senses.example: I [[bet]] the bus will be late again, since it has been raining heavily all morning.
senses.example_zh: 我敢說公車又會誤點，因為整個早上都在下大雨。
senses.note: 口語用法；常用 I bet / I'll bet

senses.en: a choice or action that is likely to succeed
senses.pattern: your best bet / a safe bet / a good bet
senses.example: If you want to avoid the crowds, your best [[bet]] is to visit the museum on a weekday morning.
senses.example_zh: 如果你想避開人潮，最好的辦法就是平日早上去參觀博物館。

senses.en: very cheap; low in price
senses.pattern: a budget airline / a budget hotel / budget travelers
senses.example: Many college students fly with [[budget]] airlines to save money for food and sightseeing.
senses.example_zh: 許多大學生搭乘廉價航空，好把錢省下來吃東西和觀光。

senses.en: to plan carefully how to use money or time
senses.pattern: budget your money / budget your time / budget $200 for food
senses.example: Living alone for the first time, Kevin had to learn to [[budget]] his monthly allowance carefully.
senses.example_zh: 第一次獨自生活，凱文必須學會仔細規劃每月的零用錢。

gsat.sentence: But learning to [[budget]] your money is the first lesson you must learn to be independent.

senses.en: to praise or honor someone or something publicly
senses.pattern: celebrate the beauty of / celebrate diversity / be celebrated for
senses.example: Many of her poems [[celebrate]] the simple beauty of village life and the courage of ordinary farmers.
senses.example_zh: 她的許多詩作歌頌鄉村生活的樸實之美，以及平凡農民的勇氣。

senses.en: a group of people with the same social and economic position
senses.pattern: the middle class / the working class / social class
senses.example: In the nineteenth century, education was a luxury that only the upper [[class]] could afford.
senses.example_zh: 在十九世紀，教育是只有上層階級才負擔得起的奢侈品。

senses.en: a level of quality or service, especially in travel
senses.pattern: first class / economy class / be in a class of its own
senses.example: We could not afford business [[class]], so we sat in the back of the plane for twelve hours.
senses.example_zh: 我們負擔不起商務艙，所以在機艙後段坐了十二個小時。

gsat.sentence: The fashion soon spread beyond the circle of the nobility to the middle [[classes]], and tea became a popular drink at the London coffee houses where people met to do business and discuss events of the day.

senses.en: the people or companies you are competing against
senses.pattern: beat the competition / stay ahead of the competition / keep an eye on the competition
senses.example: To stay ahead of the [[competition]], the small bakery introduces two new kinds of bread every month.
senses.example_zh: 為了領先競爭對手，這家小麵包店每個月都推出兩種新口味的麵包。

senses.en: happy and satisfied with what you have
senses.pattern: be content with / be content to do / feel content
senses.example: My grandfather is [[content]] with his quiet life in the countryside and never envies the rich.
senses.example_zh: 我祖父對鄉下平靜的生活感到滿足，從不羨慕有錢人。

senses.en: the amount of a substance that something contains
senses.pattern: fat content / sugar content / a high protein content
senses.example: Doctors warn that drinks with a high sugar [[content]] can lead to weight gain and tooth decay.
senses.example_zh: 醫生警告，糖分含量高的飲料可能導致體重增加和蛀牙。
senses.note: 此義為單數形，重音在前

gsat.sentence: On the contrary, baseball fans are more [[content]] to concentrate on the game’s finer details and spend the breaks between innings filling out their own private scorecards.
People only drank beverages with low alcohol [[content]].

senses.en: to officially make someone a champion, king, or queen
senses.pattern: be crowned champion / be crowned king / be crowned the winner
senses.example: After beating the defending champions in the final, our school team was [[crowned]] national champion.
senses.example_zh: 在決賽擊敗衛冕隊伍後，我們校隊被封為全國冠軍。
senses.note: 常用被動：be crowned + 頭銜

senses.en: the top part of a tree, head, or hill
senses.pattern: the crown of a tree / the crown of the head / the crown of the hill
senses.example: Monkeys leaped from one tree [[crown]] to another, hardly ever touching the forest floor.
senses.example_zh: 猴子從一個樹冠跳到另一個樹冠，幾乎從不碰到森林的地面。

gsat.sentence: In forested areas with thick tree [[crowns]], there is intense struggle for these resources.
Gaps in the treetops resulting from [[crown]] shyness may allow trees to increase their exposure to light and enhance photosynthesis.

senses.en: to search carefully for information or facts
senses.pattern: dig into the past / dig for information / dig deeper into
senses.example: The reporter spent months [[digging]] into the company's records to find out where the money had gone.
senses.example_zh: 那名記者花了好幾個月深入探究該公司的紀錄，想查出錢的去向。

senses.en: a place or project where archaeologists dig for remains
senses.pattern: an archaeological dig / go on a dig / a dig site
senses.example: During the summer, history students joined an archaeological [[dig]] and uncovered pottery from an ancient village.
senses.example_zh: 暑假期間，歷史系學生參加了一場考古挖掘，挖出古代村落的陶器。
senses.note: 另可指「挖苦的話」：take a dig at

senses.en: expected to arrive or happen at a particular time
senses.pattern: be due at noon / be due to arrive / be due back
senses.example: The next train is not [[due]] for another forty minutes, so let's grab some coffee first.
senses.example_zh: 下一班火車預定四十分鐘後才到，我們先去買杯咖啡吧。

senses.en: proper or right in the situation
senses.pattern: with due respect / due care / after due consideration / in due course
senses.example: After [[due]] consideration, the committee decided to give the young scientist a second chance.
senses.example_zh: 經過適當的考量後，委員會決定再給這位年輕科學家一次機會。
senses.note: 只用於名詞前；in due course 在適當時候

gsat.sentence: Do you know what time the next bus is [[due]]? I’ve been waiting here for more than 30 minutes.

senses.en: to be forgotten or not noticed by someone
senses.pattern: escape sb's notice / escape sb's attention / sb's name escapes me
senses.example: I know I have met that actor before, but his name [[escapes]] me at the moment.
senses.example_zh: 我知道我以前見過那位演員，但我一時忘記他的名字了。
senses.note: 主詞是事物；不用進行式和被動

senses.en: a way of forgetting your worries for a while
senses.pattern: an escape from reality / a form of escape / a temporary escape
senses.example: For many teenagers, reading fantasy novels is an [[escape]] from the pressure of endless tests.
senses.example_zh: 對許多青少年來說，讀奇幻小說是逃避現實的方式，能暫時擺脫考不完的試所帶來的壓力。

gsat.sentence: For a temporary [[escape]], she joined a small writers’ group, in which each member was required to bring a story or poem for discussion.

senses.en: to make a feeling or situation stronger
senses.pattern: fan the flames / fan fears / fan public anger
senses.example: False rumors on social media [[fanned]] public fears that the city would soon run out of water.
senses.example_zh: 社群媒體上的不實謠言助長了民眾對城市即將缺水的恐懼。

senses.en: to wave something to move air onto someone or something
senses.pattern: fan yourself / fan one's face / fan the fire
senses.example: Waiting in the hot sun, the tourists [[fanned]] themselves with folded maps and newspapers.
senses.example_zh: 在大太陽下等候時，遊客們拿摺起來的地圖和報紙替自己搧風。

senses.en: the act of running away from danger
senses.pattern: take flight / fight or flight / flight from the war zone
senses.example: When the fire alarm rang, the frightened crowd took [[flight]] and rushed toward the nearest exits.
senses.example_zh: 火災警報響起時，受驚的人群紛紛逃跑，衝向最近的出口。

senses.en: a set of stairs between two floors
senses.pattern: a flight of stairs / climb three flights / two flights up
senses.example: My grandmother's knees hurt whenever she climbs more than one [[flight]] of stairs.
senses.example_zh: 我祖母只要爬超過一段樓梯，膝蓋就會痛。

senses.en: to work properly or serve a particular purpose
senses.pattern: function as / function properly / function normally
senses.example: The old church now [[functions]] as a community library where children gather after school.
senses.example_zh: 這座老教堂現在充當社區圖書館，孩子們放學後都會聚在那裡。

senses.en: a formal social event or official ceremony
senses.pattern: a social function / attend a function / an official function
senses.example: The hotel's ballroom is often rented out for weddings, charity dinners, and other formal [[functions]].
senses.example_zh: 這家飯店的宴會廳常出租舉辦婚禮、慈善晚宴和其他正式聚會。

gsat.sentence: They [[functioned]] as a funeral offering shown upon the altars of the gods.
John’s clock is not [[functioning]] properly. The alarm rings even when it’s not set to go off.

senses.en: to listen to and judge a case in court
senses.pattern: hear a case / hear evidence / hear an appeal
senses.example: The case will be [[heard]] by three judges next month, and the public may attend.
senses.example_zh: 這起案件下個月將由三位法官審理，民眾可以旁聽。

senses.en: without any real purpose, basis, or effect
senses.pattern: an idle threat / idle talk / idle gossip / idle curiosity
senses.example: The coach's warning was no [[idle]] threat; two players who skipped practice were removed from the team.
senses.example_zh: 教練的警告可不是空洞的威脅；兩名蹺掉練習的球員已被踢出球隊。

senses.en: (of an engine) to run slowly without moving the vehicle
senses.pattern: leave the engine idling / let the engine idle / an idling car / idle at a red light
senses.example: Drivers are asked not to leave their engines [[idling]] outside the school, since it pollutes the air.
senses.example_zh: 請駕駛人不要在學校外面讓引擎怠速空轉，因為這樣會污染空氣。

senses.en: an event marking an important stage in development
senses.pattern: a landmark in the history of / a major landmark / a landmark in medicine
senses.example: The invention of the printing press was a [[landmark]] in the history of human communication.
senses.example_zh: 印刷機的發明是人類傳播史上的里程碑。

senses.en: very important and marking a turning point
senses.pattern: a landmark decision / a landmark study / a landmark agreement
senses.example: In a [[landmark]] study, researchers followed five thousand children for thirty years to track their health.
senses.example_zh: 在一項具里程碑意義的研究中，研究人員追蹤五千名兒童的健康狀況長達三十年。

senses.en: living; not dead
senses.pattern: live animals / live fish / live bait
senses.example: The market sells [[live]] chickens and fish, which shocks some tourists from big cities.
senses.example_zh: 那個市場販賣活的雞和魚，讓一些來自大城市的遊客很震驚。
senses.note: 形容詞讀作 /laɪv/；只用於名詞前

senses.en: performed or broadcast as it happens, not recorded
senses.pattern: a live concert / live music / a live broadcast
senses.example: The café near our school has [[live]] music every Friday night, performed by local student bands.
senses.example_zh: 我們學校附近的咖啡廳每週五晚上都有現場音樂演出，由本地學生樂團表演。
senses.note: 也作副詞：broadcast live 現場直播

senses.en: connected to a source of electricity
senses.pattern: a live wire / live cables / live electrical equipment
senses.example: Never touch a fallen power line after a typhoon, because the wire may still be [[live]].
senses.example_zh: 颱風過後千萬不要碰掉落的電線，因為電線可能還是通電的。

gsat.sentence: After testing these brands on five different groups of [[live]] bedbugs for two hours, the scientists saw that the foggers had little—if any—effect on the insects.

senses.en: to be important or have an effect
senses.pattern: matter to sb / it doesn't matter / what matters most
senses.example: What really [[matters]] to the coach is not winning but how hard each player tries.
senses.example_zh: 對教練來說，真正重要的不是贏球，而是每位球員有多努力。

senses.en: the physical substance that all things are made of
senses.pattern: organic matter / waste matter / solid matter
senses.example: Fallen leaves and other organic [[matter]] slowly break down and return nutrients to the soil.
senses.example_zh: 落葉和其他有機物質會慢慢分解，把養分送回土壤。

gsat.sentence: It is not exactly what a child eats that truly [[matters]], but how much time it stays in his mouth.
The dead material and waste [[matter]] form the diet of a group of living organisms called decomposers.

senses.en: the power or influence to get things done
senses.pattern: financial muscle / political muscle / economic muscle
senses.example: Small bookstores lack the financial [[muscle]] to compete with giant online retailers on price.
senses.example_zh: 小書店缺乏財務實力，無法和大型網路零售商打價格戰。

senses.en: to obey a law, rule, or custom
senses.pattern: observe the rules / observe the law / observe the speed limit
senses.example: All swimmers must [[observe]] the safety rules posted at the entrance to the pool.
senses.example_zh: 所有泳客都必須遵守張貼在泳池入口的安全規定。

senses.en: to celebrate or mark a festival or special day
senses.pattern: observe a holiday / observe a festival / observe Christmas
senses.example: Earth Day is [[observed]] in many countries with tree planting and beach cleanups.
senses.example_zh: 許多國家以植樹和淨灘活動來慶祝世界地球日。

senses.en: to make a remark about something you have noticed
senses.pattern: observe that… / as sb once observed / he observed dryly
senses.example: “You seem much happier since you changed schools,” my aunt [[observed]] over dinner.
senses.example_zh: 「你轉學之後好像快樂多了。」阿姨吃晚餐時這麼說。
senses.note: 名詞 observation 可指「評論」

gsat.sentence: Proper social behavior must be [[observed]] by prom-goers.
Since then, World Hello Day—November 21st of every year—has been [[observed]] by people in 180 countries.

senses.en: to have a view of something from above
senses.pattern: overlook the sea / overlook the valley / a room overlooking the park
senses.example: Our hotel room [[overlooked]] a quiet lake surrounded by pine trees and snow-capped mountains.
senses.example_zh: 我們的飯店房間俯瞰一座寧靜的湖，四周環繞著松樹和白雪覆頂的群山。

senses.en: to forgive or ignore someone's fault or mistake
senses.pattern: overlook a mistake / overlook sb's faults / overlook it this time
senses.example: The teacher agreed to [[overlook]] my lateness this time because the bus had broken down.
senses.example_zh: 老師同意這次不計較我遲到，因為公車拋錨了。

gsat.sentence: So we went to the restaurant and sat by a window [[overlooking]] the bay.
On a hilltop [[overlooking]] the 2011-tsunami hit Otsuchi Town in northeastern Japan, there is a white phone booth standing all alone in the wind.

senses.en: the mark used at the end of a sentence
senses.pattern: put a period / end with a period / a period at the end
senses.example: Remember to put a [[period]] at the end of every statement in your English composition.
senses.example_zh: 記得在英文作文的每個直述句句尾加上句號。
senses.note: 美式用法；英式稱 full stop

senses.en: used to show that a decision is final
senses.pattern: …, period. / No excuses, period. / I'm not going, period.
senses.example: You are not going to the concert on a school night, [[period]]!
senses.example_zh: 平日晚上你不准去聽演唱會，就這樣，不必多說！
senses.note: 口語；置於句尾表示沒有商量餘地

senses.en: to burst, or make something burst, with a short sound
senses.pattern: pop a balloon / the balloon popped / pop popcorn
senses.example: The little boy cried when his red balloon touched a rose bush and [[popped]].
senses.example_zh: 小男孩的紅氣球碰到玫瑰叢，砰的一聲爆開，他就哭了。

senses.en: to appear or go somewhere suddenly or quickly
senses.pattern: pop up / pop into the store / pop out for lunch
senses.example: A warning message [[popped]] up on the screen just as I was about to save my report.
senses.example_zh: 我正要儲存報告時，螢幕上突然出現一則警告訊息。
senses.note: 口語用法；後接 up, in, out 等副詞

gsat.sentence: When the kernels start [[popping]], shake the pot to let the steam escape and to let the unpopped kernels fall to the bottom.
Make sure you don’t squeeze or [[pop]] a stye like you would a pimple.

senses.en: to value something very highly
senses.pattern: be prized for / be highly prized / prize freedom
senses.example: This rare tea is highly [[prized]] by collectors for its rich flavor and long history.
senses.example_zh: 這種稀有的茶因風味濃郁、歷史悠久而深受收藏家珍視。

gsat.sentence: Cartier-Bresson’s subsequent work to document Gandhi’s death and its immediate impact on the country became one of Life Magazine’s most [[prized]] photo essays.
They were [[prized]] possessions made of expensive materials intended to impress guests.

senses.en: a group of people with shared ancestry and physical features
senses.pattern: people of all races / regardless of race / race and gender
senses.example: The law protects every citizen from unfair treatment, regardless of [[race]], religion, or gender.
senses.example_zh: 這項法律保護每位公民不受不公平對待，不分種族、宗教或性別。

senses.en: to move or beat extremely fast
senses.pattern: sb's heart races / race to the hospital / race down the stairs
senses.example: My heart was [[racing]] as I stepped onto the stage to give my first speech.
senses.example_zh: 我走上講臺發表第一次演講時，心臟狂跳不已。

gsat.sentence: Their unique style, as remarked by Karen Blixen, author of Out of Africa, “has grown from the inside, and is an expression of the [[race]] and its history.”

senses.en: food, money, or help given to people in need
senses.pattern: disaster relief / relief supplies / relief workers / flood relief
senses.example: Trucks loaded with [[relief]] supplies reached the mountain village three days after the landslide.
senses.example_zh: 滿載救濟物資的卡車在山崩發生三天後抵達那座山村。

senses.en: a design that stands out from a flat surface
senses.pattern: a stone relief / carved in relief / a relief sculpture
senses.example: The temple walls are covered with stone [[reliefs]] showing scenes from ancient legends.
senses.example_zh: 廟宇的牆上布滿石刻浮雕，呈現古代傳說中的場景。

senses.en: one stage in a series of events or a competition
senses.pattern: a round of talks / the first round / a round of applause
senses.example: Our debate team was knocked out in the second [[round]] of the national tournament.
senses.example_zh: 我們的辯論隊在全國錦標賽的第二輪就被淘汰了。
senses.note: a round of applause 一陣掌聲

senses.en: to go around a corner or bend
senses.pattern: round the corner / round a bend / round the final turn
senses.example: As the bus [[rounded]] the corner, we caught our first sight of the sea.
senses.example_zh: 公車繞過轉角時，我們第一次瞥見了大海。

gsat.sentence: This in turn enriched subsequent [[rounds]] of conversation.

senses.en: to follow and watch someone closely, often secretly
senses.pattern: shadow a suspect / shadow someone closely / be shadowed by detectives
senses.example: Two detectives [[shadowed]] the suspect for a week, noting everyone he met and every place he visited.
senses.example_zh: 兩名警探跟蹤嫌犯一星期，記下他見過的每個人和去過的每個地方。

senses.en: a very small amount of something, especially doubt
senses.pattern: beyond a shadow of a doubt / without a shadow of a doubt / not a shadow of doubt
senses.example: The video proved beyond a [[shadow]] of a doubt that the driver had run the red light.
senses.example_zh: 這段影片證明駕駛確實闖了紅燈，沒有一絲懷疑的餘地。

senses.en: a photograph, or a single scene in a film
senses.pattern: take a shot of / get a good shot / a close-up shot
senses.example: The photographer waited two hours by the lake to get a perfect [[shot]] of the sunrise.
senses.example_zh: 那位攝影師在湖邊等了兩個小時，才拍到一張完美的日出照片。

senses.en: an injection of a medicine or vaccine
senses.pattern: a flu shot / get a shot / give sb a shot
senses.example: The nurse told the little girl that the [[shot]] would hurt only for a second.
senses.example_zh: 護理師告訴小女孩，打針只會痛一下下。

senses.en: an attempt to do or achieve something
senses.pattern: give it a shot / have a shot at / take a shot at
senses.example: I had never tried rock climbing before, but I decided to give it a [[shot]].
senses.example_zh: 我以前從沒試過攀岩，但我決定嘗試看看。

gsat.sentence: You may have to wait for a while until the animal does something interesting or moves into a position for you to get a good [[shot]].
Getting a flu [[shot]] before the start of flu season gives our body a chance to build up protection against the virus that could make us sick.

senses.en: to move or stretch in long, twisting curves
senses.pattern: snake through / snake along / snake around / snake its way
senses.example: A narrow mountain road [[snakes]] through the tea fields before reaching the village at the top.
senses.example_zh: 一條狹窄的山路蜿蜒穿過茶園，最後通到山頂的村莊。

senses.en: to put a soft substance over a surface
senses.pattern: spread butter on bread / spread jam on toast / spread glue evenly
senses.example: He [[spread]] a thick layer of peanut butter on his toast and ate it in three bites.
senses.example_zh: 他在吐司上抹了厚厚一層花生醬，三口就吃完了。
senses.note: 名詞可指「抹醬」，如 cheese spread

senses.en: to divide something over a period or among people
senses.pattern: spread the cost / spread the payments over / spread the risk / spread the workload
senses.example: The store lets customers [[spread]] the cost of a new laptop over twelve monthly payments.
senses.example_zh: 這家店讓顧客把新筆電的費用分攤成十二期，按月付款。

senses.en: a person in a place they do not know
senses.pattern: a stranger in town / be a stranger here / a stranger to the city
senses.example: Sorry, I can't tell you where the post office is; I'm a [[stranger]] here myself.
senses.example_zh: 抱歉，我沒辦法告訴你郵局在哪裡，我自己也是外地人。

senses.en: someone with no experience of something
senses.pattern: be no stranger to / be a stranger to / a complete stranger to
senses.example: Having grown up in a fishing village, Amy is no [[stranger]] to hard work and early mornings.
senses.example_zh: 艾咪在漁村長大，對辛苦的工作和早起並不陌生。
senses.note: 常用 be no stranger to 對…並不陌生

senses.en: to appear or become known after being hidden
senses.pattern: problems surface / doubts surface / new evidence surfaced
senses.example: Old arguments between the two brothers [[surfaced]] again when they had to share a room.
senses.example_zh: 這對兄弟被迫共用一個房間時，過去的爭執又再度浮現。

senses.en: to rise to the top of the water
senses.pattern: surface for air / surface to breathe / the diver surfaced
senses.example: The whale [[surfaced]] beside our boat, took a deep breath, and disappeared into the waves.
senses.example_zh: 那頭鯨魚在我們的船邊浮出水面，深吸一口氣，然後消失在海浪中。

gsat.sentence: Mistrust increases and rejection and repression [[surface]].

senses.en: however; used to add a contrasting comment
senses.pattern: …, though. / It was fun, though. / Thanks, though.
senses.example: The hike to the waterfall was exhausting; the view at the top was worth it, [[though]].
senses.example_zh: 走到瀑布的那段路累死人了，不過山頂的景色很值得。
senses.note: 口語常用；多置於句尾，前加逗號

gsat.sentence: I did NOT like the price, [[though]].
Not all dimples are formed by a genetic defect, [[though]]; some may appear due to the presence of excessive fat on the face.

senses.en: something special and enjoyable, especially nice food
senses.pattern: a special treat / a birthday treat / a sweet treat / as a treat
senses.example: Eating out is a rare [[treat]] for our family, so we always choose the restaurant carefully.
senses.example_zh: 外出用餐對我們家來說是難得的樂事，所以我們總是仔細挑選餐廳。

senses.en: to buy or pay for something special for someone
senses.pattern: treat sb to dinner / treat sb to a movie / treat yourself to
senses.example: To thank us for helping her move, Lisa [[treated]] us to dinner at a seafood restaurant.
senses.example_zh: 為了感謝我們幫她搬家，麗莎在海鮮餐廳請我們吃晚餐。

senses.en: to use a chemical or process to protect or clean something
senses.pattern: treat water / treat wood with / be treated with chemicals
senses.example: The wooden fence was [[treated]] with a special oil to protect it from rain and insects.
senses.example_zh: 這道木圍籬用一種特殊的油處理過，以防雨淋和蟲蛀。

gsat.sentence: This story may sound highly credible, but there seems to be no solid evidence that it inspired the creation of the [[treats]] we know of today as fortune cookies.
Rely on its owner to point out where a [[treat]] is.

senses.en: to express a feeling or opinion in words
senses.pattern: voice concerns / voice an opinion / voice doubts / voice support
senses.example: Several parents [[voiced]] concerns about the heavy schoolbags their children carry every day.
senses.example_zh: 幾位家長對孩子每天背的沉重書包表達了憂慮。

senses.en: the right to express opinions and influence decisions
senses.pattern: have a voice in / give sb a voice / the voice of the people
senses.example: The principal believes that students should have a [[voice]] in deciding the school's dress code.
senses.example_zh: 校長認為，學生對於學校服裝規定的制定應該有發言權。

gsat.sentence: His art thoughtfully expressed the [[voices]] of people suffering from war.

senses.en: at the same time or rate as something
senses.pattern: with age / with time / with experience / with the seasons
senses.example: Our eyesight tends to get worse [[with]] age, especially when we stare at screens all day.
senses.example_zh: 我們的視力往往隨著年齡增長而變差，尤其是整天盯著螢幕的時候。

senses.en: because of or as a result of something
senses.pattern: with all this noise / shake with fear / with the exams coming
senses.example: [[With]] the final exams only a week away, the library is packed until closing time.
senses.example_zh: 由於期末考只剩一週，圖書館直到閉館時間都擠滿了人。

gsat.sentence: [[With]] some six hundred years of architecture nearly untouched by natural disaster or war, the city retains much of its medieval appearance.

quiz.stem: Drivers who fail to ______ the speed limit near schools will be fined heavily under the new traffic law.
quiz.explain_zh: observe＝遵守（規定）。在學校附近不遵守速限的駕駛將被重罰。

quiz.stem: The international ______ effort began within hours of the flood, bringing food, clean water, and medicine to thousands of homeless villagers.
quiz.explain_zh: relief＝救濟。洪水後數小時內國際救濟行動展開，送來食物、水和藥品。

quiz.stem: Unlike her classmates, who dream of studying abroad, Mia is perfectly ______ to stay in her hometown and help run the family farm.
quiz.explain_zh: content＝滿足的、甘願的。米亞甘願留在家鄉幫忙經營家裡的農場。

quiz.stem: Because the elevator was out of order, the delivery man had to carry the heavy boxes up five ______ of stairs to reach our apartment.
quiz.explain_zh: flight＝一段樓梯。電梯故障，送貨員只好搬著箱子爬五段樓梯。

quiz.stem: Doubts about the safety of the new drug ______ last month when several patients reported severe headaches and dizziness after taking it.
quiz.explain_zh: surface＝浮現、顯露。數名病人服藥後頭痛暈眩，新藥安全的疑慮隨之浮現。

quiz.stem: At the public hearing, many angry residents ______ strong opposition to the plan to build a waste treatment plant near the elementary school.
quiz.explain_zh: voice＝表達（意見）。居民在公聽會上表達對興建廢棄物處理廠的強烈反對。

quiz.stem: Since we could not afford a five-star resort, we booked a ______ hotel near the train station and spent the money we saved on local food.
quiz.explain_zh: budget＝平價的。住不起五星級度假村，所以訂了車站附近的平價旅館。

quiz.stem: By the time the museum opened, a long line of visitors was already ______ around the corner and down the street.
quiz.explain_zh: snake＝蜿蜒伸展。博物館開門時，排隊人龍已蜿蜒繞過轉角、延伸到街上。

quiz.stem: As a special ______ for finishing the exams, Dad took us to an amusement park and let us stay until the fireworks ended.
quiz.explain_zh: treat＝難得的樂事。考完試後爸爸帶我們去遊樂園作為特別的犒賞。

quiz.stem: The old lighthouse stands on a cliff that ______ the fishing village, offering visitors a wonderful view of the boats and the coastline.
quiz.explain_zh: overlook＝俯瞰。老燈塔矗立在俯瞰漁村的懸崖上，可飽覽船隻與海岸線。
